c57423154.notes: Weathered painted board with the USP logo in front of the Tuvalu campus, Funafuti, behind a chain-link fence; a rusty post in front hides the 'U' of TUVALU (lines show only what is visible).

c63402642.notes: Black letters on a white fascia board of the terminal building, Funafuti; parked scooters in front (their plates are small and incidental).

c23363485.reason: near-duplicate of c63402642 (same Funafuti airport terminal fascia)

c49045010.notes: 1972 colour slide: hand-painted red-on-white sign (small-caps style 'FUNAFUTI INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT') over a temporary tent terminal after Hurricane Bebe; slide-mount border, faded colours. Same place name as c63402642 but a different, historic sign.

c79838328.reason: handwritten cardboard sales notice in Tuvaluan (salted fish / palu from Niutao for sale); an advert, not a place sign

c15873386.notes: Red-framed notice board in front of the met office compound in Funafuti, small in frame behind an orange fence; the dashes are long rules on the sign. Contact lines (Ph : (688) 20736 & 20090, Fax, Email : tuvmet@tuvalu.tv, Website : www.tuvalu.pacificweather.org) are tiny and not reliably legible at 1600 px, so left out. Faint coat of arms at left.

c64986174.reason: list of religious principles (slogans), no place name

c79838451.reason: no-smoking notice ('E TAPU TE PUSI') and a fuel-price advert; no place name
